source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Никандра , еп. Мирского, и Ермея пресвитера (I).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 4 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Ermeu, preotul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Νίκανδρος επίσκοπος Μύρων και Ερμαίος ο πρεσβύτερος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: the presbyter martyred with Nicander bishop of Myra, which is what the folder's office and display name already say. The page adds that the two were disciples of the apostle Titus, that they were denounced to Libanios the governor, that their torn flesh was healed by grace, and that they were buried alive. No year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. The apolytikion names both men and is taken into both folders. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Sfințiți Mucenici Nicandru, Episcopul Mirelor, și Ermeu, preotul (a common of martyrs, printed for the two of them together)

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength they overthrew the tormentors, and broke the powerless presumption of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Γνῶσιν ἔνθεον, καρποφόρησαν, ὡς ὁμότροπος, τῶν Ἀποστόλων, ἐν ἱερεύσι πιστὸς ἐχρημάτισας καὶ μαρτυρίου τοὶς σκάμμασι Νίκανδρε, συγκοινωνὸν τὸν Ἑρμαῖον ἐκέκτησο, μεθ' οὐ πρέσβευε, Κυρίω τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι, δωρήσασθαι ἠμιν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Νίκανδρος επίσκοπος Μύρων και Ερμαίος ο πρεσβύτερος». It names both of them and no other saint; it is addressed to Nicander and names Hermaeus as his partner, which is why it is taken into both folders.

english.text: Bearing the fruit of godly knowledge, as one of the Apostles' own manner of life, you were accounted faithful among priests and in the lists of martyrdom, Nicander; and you had Hermaeus for your partner. With him, intercede with the Lord who glorified you, that he may grant us his great mercy.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 4 ноября ст. ст., «(I)», repeated in the life's own first words, «Святые священномученики Никандр, епископ Мирский, и Ермей пресвитер (I)». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
